components.name: Experiment button
components.description: Bordered secondary experiment action; primary run/load actions use teal.
components.css: .ds-experiment-button { min-height: 40px; padding: .55rem .9rem; color: var(--sl-color-white); background: var(--sl-color-bg); border: 1px solid var(--pa-border); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-experiment-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sl-color-text-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Experiment numeric input
components.description: Labelled numeric parameter with native bounds and validation.
components.html: <label class="ds-experiment-label">初始速度 (m/s)<input class="ds-experiment-input" type="number" min="-20" max="20" step="0.1" value="0" required></label>
components.css: .ds-experiment-label { display: grid; gap: .5rem; } .ds-experiment-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: .6rem .75rem; background: var(--sl-color-bg); color: var(--sl-color-white); border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-gray-4); border-radius: 6px; }

narrative.overview: User-approved textbook redesign: clear numbered chapters, restrained teal accents, self-hosted Inter with Chinese system fallbacks, and integrated experiment surfaces. Preserve Starlight navigation and all existing lesson functionality.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar documentation navigation and reading hierarchy.
Theme-aware controls integrated into the lesson.
Explicit distinction between precomputed references and local simulation results.
dos: Keep the seven approved chapter titles and appendices A–D.
Use editorial.css semantic colors and the documented 4/6/8/12px radius scale.
Preserve focus, units, statuses and reference/local result distinctions.
donts: Do not invent lesson subsections during visual work.
Do not imply that parameter edits recompute a reference chart.
